case_number: 2023 INSC 788; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. [OMITTED] OF 2023 [ARISING OUT OF SLP (CRIMINAL) NO. 8510 OF 2023]
summary: Preventive detention challenged via habeas corpus; Detenu categorized as 'Goonda' under Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act 1986; detention based on 9 post-release offenses including assaulting women, cheating, extortion; detaining authority's satisfaction examined; judicial review scope clarified - not appellate but must meet objective standards; failure to consider representation adequately; grounds vague; detention set aside as malafide and excessive.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 3(2), Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act 1986
Section 10, Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act 1986
Section 12(1), Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act 1986
Section 13, Telangana Prevention of Dangerous Activities Act 1986
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; detention order quashed; Detenu to be released within 48 hours.
